entries.msgstr: A: In the Garage, select a vehicle and place the purchased equipment in a free slot to the left of the shell slots.

A: Determine the enemy's location and position your vehicle so that the bush is between you and the enemy. Do not worry if your vehicle's gun sticks out of the bush, it will not make you more noticeable.
A: These are the penetration ratings for each different shell type available for that gun.
A: No, they will not disappear, but they will not continue in effect until the crew member is retrained for this vehicle.
A: Yes. You will benefit from both.
A: Center the reticle indicator on the enemy vehicle and click the right mouse button.
A: Press and hold the right mouse button to look around without turning your turret.
A: It weakens the "burn" effect of a High-Explosive shell if the shell does not penetrate the armor. It also reduces damage from ramming, protects the crew from injuries, and reduces stun duration.
A: {openSupportURL[openTag]:s}User Support Center{openSupportURL[closeTag]:s}
A: Right-click the vehicle, select "Sell", and demount all the equipment.
A: A player does not have a tier, but a vehicle does. You can see the tier of each vehicle at the bottom part of the Garage: a Roman numeral at the upper left corner on the vehicle icon.
A: No. The Rammer, Gun Laying Drive, and Stabilizer are mounted on the vehicle and stay there even if the gun is replaced.
A: Press Shift to enable/disable SPG Artillery mode.
A: To select a shell type, left-click on the required shell type in the Service bar.
A: Camouflage Net only affects the vehicle it was mounted on. It becomes effective three seconds after the vehicle stops moving and will not disappear after a battle.
A: No, a Fire Extinguisher disappears only if it is used in a battle.
A: Light tanks are designed to detect enemy vehicles. Scouts can often perform their mission without attempting to engage the enemy.
Q: I have purchased equipment in the Store. How do I mount it on my vehicle?
Q: What is the best way to use bushes to hide?
Q: What is the meaning of the penetration numbers in the gun characteristics, for example, "112/189/29"?
Q: If I send a crew member to another vehicle, will additional perks disappear?
Q: If I purchase a Premium Account and a premium vehicle at the same time, will I benefit from both of them?
Q: How do I enable Auto-Aim?
Q: How do I look around without rotating the turret?
Q: What is the benefit of a Spall Liner?
Q: Whom do I contact for technical and financial issues?
Q: How do I sell a vehicle?
Q: What is my tier?
Q: Will my tank's Rammer, Gun Laying Drive, Stabilizer, and Improved Aiming be destroyed when I replace the vehicle's gun?
Q: How do I enable/disable SPG Artillery mode?
Q: How do I select a shell type before the battle?
Q: If I purchase a Camouflage Net, will it be compatible with all my vehicles? Will it disappear after the battle?
Q: Do Fire Extinguishers disappear after the battle?
Q: Why do other types of vehicles sometimes considerably outperform my light tank in terms of firepower?
